questions.prompt: The Catechism distinguishes heresy, apostasy and schism precisely. Which describes schism?

questions.prompt: Nicaea II's answer to iconoclasm turns on a distinction the Greek makes more sharply than English: 'proskynesis' offered to images versus 'latria' reserved to God. Why was having two words essential rather than merely convenient?
